facts.fact: ARTCI launched Certinum on 2 July 2026, an online platform for compliance and processing-authorisation requests under the personal data protection regime, replacing about 100 paper files handled each month; the document does not name the law.
facts.system: Personal data protection regime (compliance and authorisation procedures)

facts.fact: ARTCI officially launched the Certinum dematerialised platform for personal data compliance and authorisation requests on 2 July 2026, with the Treasury and ONECI the first two bodies to use it.
